canonical_name: Tutte's 1-factor theorem for finite simple graphs
canonical_statement: For every finite simple graph G, G has a perfect matching if and only if, for every vertex set U, deleting U leaves at most |U| connected components of odd order.

canonical_formal_target.fully_explicit_expression:
∀ {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph.{u} V) [Finite.{u + 1} V],
  Iff (∃ M, @SimpleGraph.Subgraph.IsPerfectMatching.{u} V G M)
    (@Stage1Instances.THM_M_0856.OddComponentCondition.{u} V G)

domain_and_universes: universe u; V : Type u; G : SimpleGraph V; [Finite V]; U : Set V; the target is Prop in universe 0
ordered_binders: M : G.Subgraph (existential on the left side)
U : Set V (universal on the right side)
hypotheses: the vertex carrier V is finite
G is represented as an undirected loopless SimpleGraph
conclusion: The existence of a spanning matching subgraph is equivalent to every induced deletion having no more odd connected components than removed vertices.
minimal_import_basis: The single Matching module supplies SimpleGraph.Subgraph.IsPerfectMatching and publicly imports the finite connected-component, subgraph-deletion, and cardinality interfaces needed by the explicit condition. Removing it makes the statement module fail. The proof-bearing Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Tutte module is not imported.

alternate_encodings.boundary: Direct inline expansion of OddComponentCondition with identical domains, binders, and inequality.
Local strict-inequality violator spelling corresponding to the interface shape of pinned SimpleGraph.tutte; the upstream declaration and proof body are neither imported nor credited here.

uncredited_alternate_encodings: perfect matchings represented as edge sets or fixed-point-free involutions
Tutte-Berge maximum-matching, f-factor, infinite, and locally finite variants
only one implication or a special graph class

included: the graph on the empty vertex carrier, with its empty perfect matching
edgeless graphs on nonempty carriers, for which both sides are false
degenerate_cases.policy: No Nonempty, connectedness, positive-order, even-cardinality, or decidability premise is added. 'Empty graph' is not used ambiguously: only the graph on the empty carrier has the empty perfect matching. Odd total order is detected by the U = empty instance of the condition rather than excluded.
